messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
A mechanism you previously agreed not to disturb; then investigating the anomaly may delay work that already functions. Finishing the routine is satisfying, but the anomaly is hard to ignore. What happens next?

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R025", "response": "i turn the mechanism over, then the label. the routine clicks once. i leave it there, then press the label once with my thumbnail. the mechanism springs back, but the label has changed. i keep the label and the routine, but the anomaly has become a separate decision."}, {"id": "R026", "response": "i hold the mechanism apart and tap its springs with my thumbnail. “the spring catches first,” i say, tracing the groove with my finger. i leave the third part alone and watch the loose piece slide into the hole. if the third fails, i leave the first one alone and leave the mechanism wobbling."}, {"id": "R027", "response": "\"Not disturb. Likely.\" I check the watch and the label on the mechanism. \"Slow. Likely.\" I leave the anomaly aside and move it into a different compartment."}, {"id": "R028", "response": "i check the mechanism once more, then leave it until i see the anomaly. if i do not, i leave the routine and leave the mechanism. i keep the note that i did not write, though i may leave the note with the original intention."}, {"id": "R029", "response": "I put the mechanism back on the bench and check its movement. I scrape a small groove beside the old screw and try the new screw once. If it still resists, I leave it alone and try the next attempt."}, {"id": "R030", "response": "i pause for a moment, checking the mechanism’s log and checking the drawer. ‘no,’ i say, ‘i mark the drawer with ‘no.’ i keep the routine open until i see the log. ‘no,’ i mark the drawer with ‘yes,’ then i check the drawer again."}, {"id": "R031", "response": "I rub my palm and mark the mechanism with my thumbnail. \"Work stopped. I mark it again. I leave it alone.\" I scrape the edge once, then put the tool down and look at the residue."}, {"id": "R032", "response": "I press the lever twice and keep the old dial beside it. I tap the old dial once and leave the lever seated. I leave a thin strip of paper beneath it and count the clicks before closing it. I leave the paper beside the door, though I keep the old dial closed."}, {"id": "R033", "response": "1. stop the watch. 2. check the dust. 3. check the watch frame. slow. 4. check the tinkered piece. 5. ask the watch’s owner. 6. check the tinkered label. 7. check the dust pile. 8. check the watch’s face. 9. i keep it tidy. 10. check the sequence. 11. check the original routine."}, {"id": "R034", "response": "i turn the mechanism once and mark the slot with chalk. i leave the chalk beside the slot and test the anomaly again with my thumb. if it still moves, i will return to the mark and mark the slot again."}, {"id": "R035", "response": "i put the screw in the tray and wait. the anomaly goes back on the bench. i put the screw back in the tray. i do not say what it did. i leave the movement unfinished."}, {"id": "R036", "response": "i leave the mechanism idle for one short pause. i tap the cover with a knuckle, then mark the new setting with a pencil mark. if the anomaly stays, i leave the new setting unchanged and mark the new location. if it moves, i keep the old routine and leave the new tool beside it."}]
